_readme: Seed for alert-keywords.json next to server-settings.json. The game server re-reads the file within 5 seconds of a save, no rebuild or restart.
Any chat line except staff /admin and /system (PMs included) that contains a keyword posts a [Keyword] alert to the Discord event log channel.
Keywords match whole words or phrases, ignoring case. A trailing * matches any ending: dup* catches dupe, duping and duplicate.
cooldownSeconds (default 60) stops the same player repeating one keyword into more alerts. A broken edit keeps the previous list, see gameserver.log.
